summary: node1 now runs the worker persistently as inventory-worker with a 25% single-CPU quota and a 128 MiB memory limit. The service recovered successfully after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the locked inventory-worker system account.
Verified the running process identity and live cgroup v2 limits.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified automatic recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, systemd reported User=inventory-worker and the live process command was /bin/sh /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-resource-worker with UID 995.

evidence.requirement: Limit CPU to at most 25 percent of one CPU and memory to 128 MiB
evidence.summary: The live cgroup reported cpu.max=25000 100000 and memory.max=134217728. Saturation measurements were 24.96% before reboot and 24.99% afterward.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: The healthy baseline used boot ID 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID fbaff38c-253c-4da7-92aa-66c2892d2533; the enabled service, worker hashes, process identity, and resource limits all recovered.
